ops.title: Eliminate SSH and cc-remote proxy EAGAIN syscall storms
ops.description: Owner root. User reprioritized this ahead of CCN status. Fresh4.4s fs_usage trace shows rapid write EAGAIN35 retries in ssh and cc-remote; first150000 lines contain94945 cc-remote and53286 ssh EAGAIN writes. Process inventory about260 persistent proxy helper/Sprite pairs, plus SSH. Idle helper113 sample blocked normally; cannot attribute storm to all helpers. Next map hot trace threads to exact processes and descriptors, inspect retry implementation, reproduce on hosted macOS without local load, fix and release/install while preserving remote sessions. No monorepo modification.

ops.text: Identify exact live process, descriptor and source retry path; hosted regression reproduces busy retries and proves readiness-based waiting preserves stream contents and lifecycle
Merge, release, install without interrupting existing sessions, then verify affected natural proxy activity and retain any required running-process activation limitation
